entities.summary: Yakov Aleksandrovich Slashchov-Krymsky was a Russian military officer, member of the White movement during the Russian Civil War. After leaving Crimea with the remnants of Baron Wrangel's forces, Slashchov eventually reconciled with the Soviets and returned from Constantinople to Moscow in 1921. In 1929 he was killed in his Moscow apartment by a Jew named Lazar Kalenberg, apparently in revenge for the execution of Kalenberg's brother, who'd been murdered under Slashchov's command during the Russian Civil War.
